question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**diminish**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the negative impact of climate change on agriculture.
 
• The verb needed here should convey a harmful effect on agricultural output.
 
• "**Diminish**" means to reduce or lessen, which fits the idea of decreased agricultural productivity due to droughts and floods.
 
• Other options like "**augment**", "**bolster**", and "**increase**" express improvement or growth, which contradicts the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Augment** – means to increase or make larger; opposite of what is needed here.
 
• **Bolster** – means to support or strengthen; contextually incorrect.
 
• **Increase** – means to rise or grow; opposite of the intended meaning.
